Meeting Header:
Date: 2026-05-05
Start: 17:00 PDT
Duration: ~58 minutes
Attendees: Lina Chen, Ava Martinez, Samir Patel, Jordan Lee, Priya Kapoor, Evelyn Torres + All Employees

[00:00] Lina Chen: Hey everyone, welcome to the May all-hands, um thanks for joining, we have a packed agenda, quick housekeeping - slides will be shared, recording is on.

[01:15] Ava Martinez: Quick ops note, billing and invoices team, uh the finance close for April went smoothly, thank you, and we're seeing the reserved capacity contracts ramping up which is great.

[03:40] Samir Patel: Tech update 	6 we shipped the kernel selection changes to staging last week, preliminary numbers show 12-18% lower p99 for some autoreg models, there's some variance though, uh depending on seq length and quantization profile. Note: some of the logs show odd memory churn which we're tracking.

[07:05] Jordan Lee: On the runtime side, continuous batching improvements are rolling to canary, expected to reduce cost per token for high-concurrency tenants. We're still tuning the KV-cache eviction heuristics. There was one regression in cold-start throughput, fixed in patch 0.24.3, shipped yesterday.

[10:30] Priya Kapoor: Product 	6 Q2 roadmap highlights: 1) Dedicated GA (self-serve provisioning + SLA), target late June, 2) Private deployment automation for VPC onboarding (beta customers this month), 3) Optimize: model suggestion engine for quantization and batching defaults. We'll publish the full doc after this meeting.

[13:45] Lina Chen: Thanks Priya. Quick note on go-to-market: we want a couple of marquee Dedicated customers signed before GA to validate throughput and support flows. Ava's team will coordinate.

[15:00] Ava Martinez: Yep, sales is prioritizing three enterprise pilots 	6 one fintech, one healthcare, one ecom 	6 to stress test Private deployments and security controls. We need security artifacts and SOC2 evidence ready for the healthcare pilot.

[16:30] Evelyn Torres: Hiring update 	6 we are greenlighted for 18 hires this quarter across infra, eng, and sales. Recruiting will prioritize SRE and infra kernel engineers. Interview loop and scorecard will be posted today. There's a small backlog on offer letters, we're resolving.

[19:55] Audience Q (Speaker 1): Hi, question on Dedicated GA SLA 	6 what's the target latency SLO and how will regions be handled?

[20:10] Jordan Lee: Great question. The target for GA is 50-150ms token p95 for short prompt workloads on our standard model profiles, regionally we're planning US-west, EU-west for GA and then add APAC in Q3. We'll document exact profiles per region.

[22:40] Audience Q (Speaker 2): For Private customers, is there auto-update of runtime or must they manage kernels? Also what about KMS/HSM integration?

[22:55] Samir Patel: Private has two modes 	6 managed runtime where we push updates under a scheduled cadence, and customer-owned runtime where customers control updates. KMS/HSM integrations are supported via our KMS abstraction layer; for air-gapped customers we have a deployment package and manual key import workflows.

[25:12] Lina Chen: On security, we need to make sure audit logs and SSO docs are easier to find; action item for Samir and Ava to put together a one-pager.

[26:40] Priya Kapoor: On Optimize, we saw that for ecom workloads, auto-batching + prefix caching reduced token cost by ~28% in our bench. Caveat: this was on our internal traces, external might differ. We'll run public-like benchmarks and share.

[29:05] Samir Patel: There's also a tweak to the kernel selector to prefer lower-precision paths for 8-bit quantized weights which improved throughput; some models saw higher token accuracy drop 	6 need more evals.

[31:30] Audience comment (Speaker 3): Can we get more transparency into routing policies? We saw an outage last week when fallback logic sent traffic to a slower model and latencies spiked.

[31:50] Jordan Lee: Yep that's on our radar, the fallback policies are being updated to include a cost/latency penalty threshold; we'll also add more observability hooks so devs can see routing decisions.

[34:10] Evelyn Torres: Small HR note: parental leave policy updated and flexible comp timelines posted in handbook. Also remind folks to take PTO.

[35:25] Audience Q (Speaker 4): Regarding benchmarks 	6 will you publish the raw test harness or just summary numbers?

[35:40] Samir Patel: We'll publish the harness and the datasets used (anonymized), plus the raw CSVs. The bench link will be shared in notes. Expect it by Monday.

[38:00] Lina Chen: Customer wins 	6 shout out to team for the Acme pilot 	6 they reported 40% cost savings moving to our batching + quantization recommendations. Also we closed a mid-market agreement with Atlas Health for a Private deployment.

[40:20] Ava Martinez: Marketing & GTM will surface those wins in the case studies. Please coordinate with legal on customer quotes.

[42:00] Audience Q (Speaker 5): Any update on longer-term pricing changes? People are asking about unit economics for volume discounts.

[42:20] Ava Martinez: We're refining tiered pricing for Dedicated customers and volume-based discounts will be proposed to customer success by next week. No public changes yet.

[44:10] Priya Kapoor: A quick product note on feature flags 	6 we're rolling out per-tenant defaults for caching and batching that admins can toggle. This should give customers deterministic performance without deep runtime changes.

[46:25] Audience comment: There's noise in the logs for VPC peering errors 	6 is that a known issue?

[46:40] Jordan Lee: Yes, intermittent BGP flaps in one colo caused dropped peering sessions; we've mitigated via route dampening and the colo team is following up.

[48:00] Lina Chen: Alright, we're about at time. Quick recap 	6 publish roadmap and bench artifacts, Samir and Ava one-pager on security artifacts, Evelyn post hiring plan, Priya publish feature flags doc. Any final quick questions?

[49:55] Audience (Speaker 6): Thanks, and could we get the slides and recording?

[50:05] Lina Chen: Yes 	6 slides and recording will be posted to Confluence and the all-hands channel by EOD.

[50:20] Closing remarks, Lina Chen: Thanks everyone for the hard work 	6 Q2 is big, focus on ship, support pilots for Dedicated and Private, and let's keep the cadence.

[50:45] (crosstalk / end)
